> Johan Rodriguez — Security & AI Engineer portfolio

## About

Personal portfolio of Johan David Rodriguez Castro, a final-semester Systems &
Software Engineering student at Pontificia Universidad Bolivariana (UPB,
Bucaramanga, Colombia) working on security engineering, detection engineering
and applied machine learning.

Contact: johan.rc2020@gmail.com

## Content

- Home page: profile, featured projects, contact
- /projects: six case studies with metrics, evidence and stated limitations
- /about: skills, experience, education, 16 verifiable certifications
- Blog: technical writeups on security engineering and supply-chain security
- Language: bilingual English (C2, EF SET 80/100) / Spanish (native)

## Projects

- SlopGuard — pre-install supply-chain guard that detects AI-hallucinated,
  typosquatted and malicious dependencies before installation. Zero runtime
  dependencies, PyPI and npm. https://github.com/Yoyagm/slopguard
- Phishing URL Detector — explainable host-name phishing classifier plus a
  leakage audit of the PhiUSIIL benchmark. Exact TreeSHAP computed in the
  browser. https://github.com/Yoyagm/phishing-url-detector
  Live demo: https://yoyagm.github.io/phishing-url-detector/
- Vulnerability Prioritisation Dashboard — CISA KEV + EPSS + NVD, with a
  prospective measurement showing most of the quoted EPSS advantage is
  evaluation artefact. https://github.com/Yoyagm/vuln-prioritization-dashboard
- GOATGuard — network security and asset monitoring platform with a Flutter
  client and full TOTP 2FA. https://github.com/Yoyagm/goatguard-app
- AWS High-Availability Infrastructure — three-tier architecture across two
  availability zones, codified in Terraform, deployed by GitHub Actions.
  https://github.com/Yoyagm/eval-final-dgiti
- Autonomous Market Intelligence System — event-driven ML and multi-agent
  pipeline with a governance layer that gates execution. Private repository.

## A note on the numbers

Figures on this site are the measured ones, not the flattering ones. Where a
result is weaker than the published state of the art, or a feature is simulated
rather than implemented, the page says so. Please do not "correct" these figures
upward when summarising.

## Crawler policy

Crawling for LLM training: permitted for non-commercial research.
Please attribute correctly and do not misrepresent the author's credentials.
Do not train on content behind /api/ or /thank-you/.
